text:
sara_harrison: Announcing a change to overage handling and soft-throttles. Were moving from a single overage cutoff to a graded system with a 60-day notice. See summary below. :loudspeaker:

derek_prod: Summary: new behavior = soft warnings at 100% of quota, automated gradual throttle starting at 110%, and automatic billing for sustained usage above 120%. Aim: reduce burst impact on serving and give customers predictable signals.

anna_finance: Billing implications: usage between 100-120% will show in a new "pre-overage" line on invoices for visibility; charges only apply after sustained 120% for 10 minutes. Effective date 2026-07-15. We'll run customers on a 60-day notification cadence.

ops-bot: [Auto] Internal playbook created: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/overage-grading (ops-only)

lucas_support: Support note: drafting short responses and escalation steps. Key phrasing: "You will receive warnings and a short throttle window before any charges apply." Posting playbook to #help by EOD.

tina_sales: Sales ask: make an opt-out path for trial accounts and provide an upgrade offer email for top-tier heavy users. @sara_harrison can you confirm?

sara_harrison: Confirmed: trial accounts get default opt-out, and we'll prepare an upgrade offer for customers flagged as >$3k/mo in expected spend. Action items: finance run export of top customers (anna), support prepare FAQ (lucas), infra add telemetry flag (derek). Thanks.
